data.overview: The only substantive brand-specific evidence for Space NK is an independent Good On You assessment, which rates the retailer "We Avoid" overall — scoring 1 out of 5 on each of planet, people and animals — citing a lack of disclosed climate action, no evidence of a supplier Code of Conduct or living wages, and no policy against animal testing. Space NK's own website hosts sustainability, "clean" and vegan-product pages, but the fetched text of those pages contained only navigation content and no quotable self-claims.

papers.title: Space NK Sustainability Rating
papers.summary: Good On You rates Space NK 'We Avoid' overall, scoring 1 out of 5 on planet, people and animals. It finds no evidence of lower-impact ingredients or meaningful climate action, though it credits recycling and disclosure of packaging amounts. On labour it finds no evidence of a Code of Conduct, living wages, or supplier financial security. On animals it finds no policy against animal testing and no commitment to eliminate animal-derived ingredients.

findings.text: Space NK receives the lowest possible overall rating from Good On You.
findings.quote: Based on all the publicly available information we've reviewed, we rate Space NK "We Avoid" overall.

findings.text: Its environmental rating is 'Very Poor', with no evidence of meaningful climate action or lower-impact ingredients, though it discloses recycled packaging amounts.
findings.quote: There's no evidence it's taking meaningful action to reduce its climate impacts. It recycles product packaging and discloses the amount.

findings.text: On labour, there is no evidence of a Code of Conduct or that workers are paid living wages in its supply chain.
findings.quote: There's no evidence it has a Code of Conduct. It audits some of its suppliers but does not specify what proportion.

findings.text: It has no policy against animal testing and no commitment to eliminate animal-derived ingredients.
findings.quote: It has not made any public commitments to eliminate animal-derived ingredients. It does not have a certification, policy, or statement against the use of animal testing in its supply chain.
